编辑建议一天只设一顿需要准时到场的主餐，把另外两顿安排在住宿或当天活动附近。先写: Plan one meal with a firm arrival time and keep the other two near your accommodation or activities. Set each person’s all-in budget, dietary needs, maximum wait and return time before choosing venues. Three meals do not require three distant neighborhoods.
早餐：确认住宿是否包含、开餐时间与你当天出门是否匹配；没有早餐时先查附近商户当天: Breakfast: confirm whether accommodation includes it and whether service fits your departure. Otherwise check nearby businesses’ current menus and days.
午餐：选活动附近的一顿坐下休息，或能核对配料的简单餐食；把找厕所和补水一起安排。: Lunch: choose a nearby seated break or a simple meal whose ingredients you can check, with time for a restroom and water.
晚餐：需要固定座位、较大人数或特殊饮食时先联系餐厅；交通延误概率高的远郊日不要紧: Dinner: contact the restaurant for fixed seating, larger groups or dietary requirements. Avoid a non-refundable booking immediately after a remote day trip.
订位前：看餐厅自己的入口与取消条件: Before booking: use the restaurant’s entry point and read cancellation terms
从餐厅官网进入预约平台，核对分店地址、当地日期、人数与座位类型；吧台、室外与普通: Enter the booking platform from the restaurant’s site and confirm branch, local date, party size and seating type. Counter, outdoor and dining-room seats may differ.
看清订金、预付套餐、最低消费、迟到保留时间、取消时限与未到店收费；不要把留信用卡: Read deposits, prepaid menus, minimum spend, late-arrival limits, cancellation cutoffs and no-show charges. Providing a card does not always mean the meal has been paid for.
把婴儿也计入需要的座位说明，提出儿童椅、轮椅入口、楼层或安静位置需求；收到餐厅确: Mention infants, high chairs, step-free access, floor level or a quieter seat. Obtain confirmation rather than treating a request field as a guarantee.
订不到时，编辑建议先换同店较早或较晚的时段，再问是否接受当天候位或外带。餐厅不能: If unavailable, try an earlier or later sitting, then ask about a walk-in list or takeaway. Keep another checked-menu option in the same neighborhood if nothing is confirmed, rather than waiting hungry for an unpromised table.
您好，我们希望在［当地日期／时间］用餐，共［成人／儿童／婴儿人数］，每人预算约［: Hello, we would like to dine on [local date/time] with [adults/children/infants], budgeting about [amount including tax and fees] each. We need [specific dietary requirements] and [step-free access/high chair]. Could you confirm suitable menu and seating, total charges, deposit, cancellation deadline, late-arrival policy and this branch’s full address?
饮食需求：讲清成分，也问制作过程: Dietary needs: name ingredients and ask about preparation
FDA 列出的美国九大主要过敏原是奶、蛋、鱼、甲壳类、树坚果、花生、小麦、大豆和: FDA lists nine major US food allergens: milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy and sesame. These do not cover every allergy. Use your specific ingredient names rather than broad phrases such as seafood or nuts. This is ordering preparation, not diagnosis.
先区分食物过敏、乳糜泻相关要求、宗教饮食与口味偏好，向工作人员准确说明自己的情况: Distinguish allergies, celiac-related requirements, religious diets and preferences, and accurately describe your own restrictions.
除了主料，还问汤底、酱汁、腌料及共用煎台、炸锅、夹具；“可以拿掉配料”不等于制作: Ask about stock, sauces, marinades and shared grills, fryers or utensils as well as main ingredients. Removing a topping does not establish suitable preparation.
服务员不确定时，请其向厨房核实；厨房无法确认就换明确可核对的选择，不用网评或一个: If uncertain, ask the server to check with the kitchen. Choose a verifiable alternative if the kitchen cannot confirm; reviews or a dish name cannot establish safety.
素食或不辣，不等于满足其他饮食要求: Vegetarian or mild does not settle every dietary need
编辑建议逐项问：是否含肉汤、鱼类调味、奶蛋、酒精或你要避开的成分。需要 hala: Ask explicitly about meat stock, fish-based flavorings, dairy, eggs, alcohol or other excluded ingredients. Confirm the scope and evidence for standards such as halal or kosher with the business. This guide does not certify a neighborhood, cuisine or merchant.
我对［具体食材英文名称］过敏，不是口味偏好。请向厨房确认这道菜的主料、酱汁、汤底: I am allergic to [ingredient]. This is not a preference. Please check the ingredients, sauces, stock and shared equipment with the kitchen. If you cannot confirm, please tell me and I will choose something else.
购买包装食品时，逐次读配料表和 Contains 声明，不凭包装颜色或以前买过同: Read the ingredient list and Contains statement each time you buy packaged food; packaging color or a previous purchase is not enough. Packaged-label rules do not replace restaurant communication. If you have an allergy emergency plan, prepare according to your clinical team’s personal guidance and avoid experimenting with uncertain food while traveling.
三种街区用餐路线：按日期选一条: Three neighborhood meal plans: choose one for the date
海滨市集版适合周六上午，或周二、周四午餐前后。Foodwise 官方列 Ferr: The waterfront market option suits Saturday morning or Tuesday and Thursday around lunch. Foodwise lists Saturday 8am–2pm and Tuesday/Thursday 10am–2pm. The Ferry Building itself normally opens 6am–10pm daily, but individual businesses keep their own hours.
编辑路线 A：Ferry Building 吃一顿，再走一小段海滨: Editorial route A: one meal at Ferry Building and a short waterfront walk
这是一条可随时缩短的用餐路线，不要求把每个摊位吃一遍。: This meal-centered route can be shortened at any point; sampling every stall is unnecessary.
到场先看菜单与休息点: Start with menus and rest points
先确认今天有没有户外市集，再找洗手间与可用座位；Foodwise 列建筑内南北通: Confirm whether the outdoor market runs today, then locate seating and restrooms; Foodwise lists accessible public toilets in the building’s north and south passages.
买少量即食，或坐下吃主餐: Buy a small ready-to-eat meal or sit down
先问分量和价格，不把市集等同低价超市；买需要冷藏的东西前先决定何时回住处。: Ask about portions and prices; a market is not necessarily a discount supermarket. Decide when you will return before buying refrigerated goods.
按天气短走后返程: Take a weather-dependent stroll and return
风大就留在建筑内已营业区域，或直接返程；Ferry Building 不提供储物: In strong wind, use open indoor areas or return. Ferry Building has no lockers, so buy only what you can carry.
查看 Ferry Plaza 当天市集与访客设施: Check Ferry Plaza market days and facilities
出发前确认市集时段、商户与支付方式；官网说多数摊位接受卡或非接触支付，不代表每个: Check hours, vendors and payment methods. The organizer says most sellers take cards or contactless payments, not that every stall accepts every method.
室内选项可放在日本城 Japan Center 一带。社区官方页列商场地址 17: For an indoor option, consider Japan Center. The community site lists 1737 Post Street and public mall hours of 8:30am–10pm, explicitly noting individual merchant schedules. Choose a meal suitable for the group, then browse one or two shops; mall closing time is not a kitchen’s last order.
周四下午已在 Mission 的游客，可把 Mission Community: Visitors already in Mission on Thursday afternoon can include Mission Community Market. Foodwise currently lists Thursdays 3–7pm, March–November, at Bartlett and 22nd Streets. Buy a modest amount and dine nearby; on other days use ordinary businesses rather than expecting the market.
用官方目录核对日本城商户: Use the community directory to check Japantown merchants
由商场页进入商户信息，再确认实际店铺的菜单、休息日和预约入口；目录列名不是本站口: Follow merchant information from the mall page and verify the business’s own menu, closed days and booking entry. A directory listing is not a taste ranking or allergy-safety certification.
短住买菜：按住宿设备决定购物量: Groceries for a short stay: match purchases to the accommodation
先问住宿是否有可用冰箱、餐具、饮水和可用厨房；“房间有吧台”或“有咖啡机”不等于: Confirm a usable fridge, utensils, water and kitchen. A minibar or coffee machine does not mean cooking is possible.
无厨房时优先买当天可吃完的食物；要冷藏的东西只在能妥善运输和存放时购买，别带着逛: Without a kitchen, favor food you can finish that day. Buy chilled items only when you can transport and store them properly rather than carrying them all day.
带购物袋，按人数与剩余晚数买；先看按磅、按件还是按盒标价，比较同一单位后再决定。: Bring a bag and shop for the party size and nights remaining. Check whether pricing is per pound, item or container before comparing like units.
返程要带食品时，另查目的地入境与航空行李规则；现场买得到，不代表能带入另一个国家: For food taken home, separately check destination entry and airline baggage rules. Local availability does not establish permission to import it elsewhere.
编辑建议预留一间住宿附近、已核对营业的普通餐饮点，不把农夫市集当唯一补给来源。若: Keep a nearby food option with confirmed hours instead of relying solely on a farmers market. Use it if weather, an absent vendor or uncertain ingredients disrupt the plan, rather than crossing the city for a particular item.
结账：看清菜单价、税、强制费用和自愿小费: At payment: separate menu price, tax, mandatory charges and optional tips
加州司法部当前说明：餐厅、酒吧及部分餐饮商户在显著披露的条件下，可以把某些强制费: California DOJ currently explains that restaurants, bars and certain food businesses may list mandatory charges separately when conspicuously disclosed. Do not assume the general hidden-fee rule makes a menu price the final total. Read footnotes and ask about service charges, menu supplements and tax.
小费是自愿加给员工的款项；服务费是否属于小费不能一概而论，加州劳工专员的 FAQ: Tips are voluntarily added for staff; a service charge’s treatment depends on the circumstances, as the California Labor Commissioner explains. If the bill includes service charge or gratuity, ask what is already included before deciding on anything extra. Suggested terminal percentages are not automatically another obligation.
用一张账单核对表控制预算: Use a bill checklist to control the budget
编辑示例：菜单项目合计 $40，若事先披露服务费 5%，该项就是 $2；再核对账: Editorial example: a $40 menu subtotal with a disclosed 5% service charge adds $2. Then check actual tax, any included gratuity and your chosen extra tip. These figures illustrate arithmetic, not a universal SF rate or restaurant quote.
确认人数、菜品、数量与取消的项目是否正确，折扣是否适用于本次消费。: Check party size, dishes, quantities, canceled items and whether any discount applies.
有疑问先请工作人员解释，保留明细收据与预订条件；不要拍到其他顾客的支付信息。: Ask staff to explain unclear items and keep the itemized receipt and booking terms without capturing other customers’ payment information.
在同一份日预算里加入外卖配送、饮品、交通和购物；餐厅预约成功不代表其中任何一项免: Include delivery, drinks, transport and shopping in the daily budget. A confirmed restaurant booking does not make any of them free.
